page.layout: One printed page, one column of text; heading centred above it. No margin notes. Catchword line at foot: "* 3 me" appears as a signature-like mark with a catchword "me".
page.notes: Scan is a single printed page; the line "* 3 me" is treated as the signature and catchword. Some ligatures and hyphenated line ends were normalised ("lite-ræ" joined as "literæ", "affe-ctus" as "affectus", "confir-mabant" as "confirmabant", "Profef-sionem" as "Professionem", "offereba-tis" as "offerebatis", "inex-pectatum" as "inexpectatum", "ac-cidit" as "accidit"). The printed text has "s" long s forms rendered as plain s. Marks "s" in "Professionem" and "sionem" transcribed as printed. Faint marks at the right edge and bottom right (digitiser text) omitted.
